# Archives

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Formats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class Archives
```

Dispatch over the archive types by extension, so callers that accept "any nfty file" (the CLI's `inspect`, a GUI open dialog) resolve the kind in one place.

## Methods

### KindOf(string) { #m-kindof-system-string }

```csharp
public static ArchiveKind KindOf(string path);
```

The archive kind for `path`. An unknown extension is an error rather than a guess — the same rule color specs follow.

**Parameters**

- `path` (`string`) - A file path; only its extension is read.

**Returns.** The kind that extension names.

**Exceptions**

- `NotSupportedException` - The extension is unknown, or the path has none.

### TryKindOf(string, ArchiveKind) { #m-trykindof-system-string-nfty-core-formats-archivekind }

```csharp
public static bool TryKindOf(string path, out ArchiveKind kind);
```

The archive kind for `path`, without throwing when there is not one.

Exists so a caller that must not throw — a `System.CommandLine` validator, a GUI enabling a menu item — can ask the same question [`Archives.KindOf()`](Nfty.Core.Formats.Archives.md#m-kindof-system-string) answers, rather than re-implementing the extension table beside it. There is one switch here and two ways in; a second copy of the mapping is how `preview` came to decide its form with a string compare while dispatching on `KindOf`, leaving a switch arm no input could reach.

**Parameters**

- `path` (`string`) - The path to classify.
- `kind` (`ArchiveKind`) - The kind, when the extension names one.

**Returns.** True when the extension names one of the kinds.
